summary: Leeds Bradford airspace deactivated and aerodrome closed; suitably equipped aircraft should monitor Leeds radar on 134.580 and set code 2677.
text:
LEEDS BRADFORD CTA, CTR, ATZ DEACTIVATED, AD CLSD, ATS NOT
AVBL.SUITABLY EQUIPPED ACFT WI LEEDS BRADFORD AIRSPACE SHOULD 
MONITOR LEEDS RADAR ON CH 134.580 AND SQUAWK EITHER 2677, ANY 
DISCRETE TASK SPECIFIC CODE, OR ANY DISCRETE CODE ALLOCATED BY 
ANOTHER UNIT. MET OBS UNVERIFIED
